# Core

This section details the primary editor configuration files: setup, keybindings, and Vim settings.

## Editor Setup (`init.lua`)

The initialization file sets up bootstrapping for the plugin manager, imports option/keymap modules, and sets default themes:

* **Plugin Manager**: Automatically bootstraps and configures `lazy.nvim` as the primary plugin manager.
* **Configuration Modules**: Loads general settings from `config.options` and global shortcuts from `keymaps`.
* **Colorscheme**: Applies the `darkvoid` color theme globally on startup.
* **Custom Filetypes**: Adds filetype detection for custom file extensions (e.g., `.rsl` mapped to `rustimate`).

## Global Options (`options.lua`)

Basic editor preferences and behavior tweaks:

* **Leader Key**: Configured to `Space`.
* **Visuals**: Enables true-color (`termguicolors`) with dark background mode and relative line numbers.
* **Indentation**: Configures 2-space indentation tabs using spaces (`expandtab`).
* **Splits & Windows**: Forces horizontal splits to open below and vertical splits to open to the right.
* **Clipboard & Edit**: Integrates system clipboard via `unnamedplus` and enables block selection in `virtualedit`.

## Custom Keymaps (`keymaps.lua`)

Shortcuts mapped for daily workflow efficiency:

| Keybinding | Action / Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<leader>sv` | `<C-w>v` | Split window vertically |
| `<leader>sh` | `<C-w>s` | Split window horizontally |
| `<leader>sx` | `:close<CR>` | Close current split |
| `<leader>to` | `:tabnew<CR>` | Open new tab |
| `<leader>tx` | `:tabclose<CR>` | Close current tab |
| `<leader>tn` / `<leader>tp` | `:tabn<CR>` / `:tabp<CR>` | Next / Previous tab |
| `<leader>ff` | Telescope `find_files` | Find files in project |
| `<leader>fg` | Telescope `live_grep` | Live grep project text |
| `<leader>fb` | Telescope `buffers` | List open buffers |
| `<leader>qa` | `:QuartoActivate<CR>` | Activate Quarto mode |
| `<leader>qp` | `:QuartoPreview<CR>` | Preview Quarto document |
| `<leader>qc` | `:QuartoClosePreview<CR>` | Close Quarto preview |
| `<leader>e` | `vim.diagnostic.open_float` | Show inline diagnostic errors |
| `[d` / `]d` | Diagnostic nav | Jump to previous/next error |
